default/30554.htm.text: Miner Bolter: May Maphr, god of abundance, bless you today! Nice to meet you, young friend! How come you're in such a hurry? Did you come to the strip mine to receive training? Or are you on your way to the village? If you're going to the village, I've got a favor to ask.

Q00005_MinersFavor/30554-02.htm.text: Miner Bolter: I'm a member of the Gray Pillar Guild, which controls this Strip Mine. Those hard-working Dwarves over there are all my guild brothers. Frankly, we prefer it out here, living among the rock and rubble of the mine instead of some stuffy cottage back in the village. The only drawback is…

Q00005_MinersFavor/30554-04.html.text: Miner Bolter: Hey, you! Where's the rest of the supplies I ordered? Did you lose the list I gave you?

Q00005_MinersFavor/30554-06.html.text: Miner Bolter: You've done well, my young friend. Thanks to you, we now have all the comforts of home! Take this as a token of our gratitude. It's nothing fancy, but you might find it useful one day. In the meantime, what do you say to sharing a cold Redstone Beer with me?

Q00221_TestimonyOfProsperity/30554-01.ht.text: Miner Bolter: Well, look what the cat dragged in! Long time no see! Seems like only yesterday that you were hunting Bearded Keltirs in these parts.
